common_geometry.action_time: next available M1 open at or after decision information time
common_geometry.bar_contract: UTC, left-closed/right-open, no empty buckets, completed bars only
common_geometry.price_structure: Bid OHLC for breakout-level and directional structure; executable Bid/Ask for P/L, MFE, MAE and arming
common_geometry.symmetry: all directional comparisons multiplied by trade side; no side-specific exceptions

costs.2023_default: fixed executable Ask/Bid with 0.5-pip spread contract
costs.2024_default: actual first-tick Bid/Ask at candidate entry and exit M1 opens
costs.canonical_severe: entry and exit half-spreads each widened to 1.5 times observed half-to-half spread plus 0.5 pip adverse per side; equivalent total 1.5*(entry spread + exit spread)+1 pip
costs.trigger_spread_stress: replace candidate-action entry/exit spread with fold-specific 95th percentile M1-open spread while preserving mid; report separately and do not use for parameter selection

m30_h1_incremental_audit.question: conditional on M1/M5/M15 price-structure state, do completed M30/H1 price-structure states add economic effect?

path_authority.binding: common M1 side-specific executable path class
path_authority.p1: baseline final loss and reached +10 pips
path_authority.p2: baseline final loss, executable positive at least once, never +10 pips
path_authority.p3: baseline final loss and never executable positive
path_authority.sensitivity: 2024 exact Tick side-specific executable path class

portfolio_replay.exposure_rule: canonical baseline accepts all audited signals; no additional candidate-specific exposure suppression or cap is introduced
portfolio_replay.signal_stream: all 1,882 accepted B02/F05 signals rebuilt and identity-audited in Stage 1

required_outputs: exact-Tick Stage C arm sensitivity ledger
portfolio replay with realized drawdown and concurrency

stage_a.delayed_confirmation: do not enter at baseline Entry; enter next available M1 open only if quorum passes; preserve original strategy time cap measured from actual delayed Entry
stage_a.immediate_abort: enter at baseline Entry; if quorum fails, exit next available M1 open

observation.B02: second completed M5 after baseline Entry (10 minutes)
observation.F05: first completed M5 after baseline Entry (5 minutes)

positive_primitives: side * (observation window final Bid close - observation window first Bid open) > 0
side * (completed M5 Bid close - canonical breakout level) > 0
count(side * Bid close-to-close change > 0) > count(side * Bid close-to-close change < 0) inside observation window

stage_b.action: if quorum fails, exit next available M1 open
stage_b.arm: active only when common-M1 first positive time is at or before checkpoint and first +10 time is absent or after checkpoint; released at +10
stage_b.independence: evaluated against baseline, not chained after Stage A
positive_primitives: side * (checkpoint completed Bid close - canonical breakout level) > 0
latest block favorable executable extreme exceeds the prior post-Entry favorable peak before that block
side * (latest block final Bid close - Bid close immediately before block) > 0

stage_c.action: exit next available M1 open after trigger persistence is satisfied
deterioration_primitives: retracement from current post-arm favorable peak >= 50% of additional peak profit above +10 pips
side * (completed Bid close - canonical breakout level) <= 0
neither of latest two completed observation bars updates the post-arm favorable extreme and latest directional Bid body <= 0
stage_c.independence: evaluated against baseline, not chained after Stage A or B
stage_c.peak_prerequisite: a favorable peak strictly above +10 pips must exist after arm before a trigger can qualify

startup_record: HYP-023およびHYP-024は閉鎖済みの過去研究であり、今回の検証対象・停止条件・代替候補ではない。参照、再実行、修復、派生候補生成を行わない。
